title: The Day the Apricots Turned to Glass
description: On the orchard’s feast day, a few apricots turn to glass while still on the branch. The morning sun paints amber crescents on the slate below.
alt: A hand cups a transparent orange apricot still on its branch as sunlight through the glass casts amber crescents across a slate tabletop.
pairing: Orchard feast × apricots that turn to blown glass
